threat_event: Business email compromise diverts closing, escrow, payout, or trade partner funds in any division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 9,900 contractor agents on password-only email; agents can still forward brokerage escrow instructions by email; payee verification enforced only by Title; no alerts on payee changes in division applications
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G4; SYS-B1; SYS-B2; SYS-G5; SYS-M2; SYS-H1; SYS-B4
existing_controls: Portal-only title instructions; Title callback; dual approval and hardware-key release; positive pay; email impersonation protection; 24x7 SOC
treatment_plan: MFA for every agent; group payee verification for every division payment type through SYS-G5; payee-change alerts from division applications; agent and consumer awareness

threat_event: Contractor agent identities are compromised or kept after departure, exposing client files, Title customer information, and email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password-only agent accounts; late departure reports by managing brokers (median 4 days, up to 31); personal devices with no app protection; office-wide visibility in SYS-B1
existing_controls: Unique identities; app-based MFA for 81% of agents; inactivity disablement after 60 days
treatment_plan: Enforce MFA by 2026-12-31; automated removal from the license transfer feed; app protection on mobile email; transaction-team visibility

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services and halts closings and disbursements in all divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, email, network, and payments hub connect all divisions; Homebuilding legacy tenant and flat jobsite networks
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC with EDR; PAM; immutable backups in provider B; break-glass access
treatment_plan: Segment jobsite and sales center networks; migrate the Homebuilding legacy tenant; cross-division ransomware tabletop; bank-portal fallback drills for all divisions

threat_event: A cross-division incident misses an FTC, state, insurance regulator, investor, or SEC notice deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One notification matrix not exercised; two financial institutions each owe their own FTC notice; consumers cannot be counted per institution; state insurance law list incomplete
existing_controls: Group incident response plan; disclosure committee charter covers cyber incidents
treatment_plan: Complete and exercise the multi-regulator matrix (P08); per-institution consumer counting procedure; cross-division tabletop by 2026-12-15

threat_event: Customer information and client data move between divisions for undocumented purposes, breaching consent, FCRA, or Safeguards Rule limits
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Point-to-point lead APIs; nightly TMCC feed to the Group Data Platform; brokerage-only data mixed with Title and Home Loans customer information; no consent or retention records
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-B3; SYS-H2; SYS-M1; SYS-G3 Group Data Platform
existing_controls: Affiliated business disclosure at referral; role-based access to the Group Data Platform
treatment_plan: Data sharing register with purposes and consent basis; separate Safeguards Rule data zones in the Group Data Platform; field-level allow lists on lead APIs

threat_event: Homebuilding outside group common controls becomes the entry point for a group compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 3,800 users on a legacy directory and email tenant with SMS-only MFA; no division supplement; inheritance undocumented; flat jobsite networks
affected_asset_or_process: Homebuilding legacy tenant; SYS-H3; SYS-G1 trusts
existing_controls: EDR on Homebuilding endpoints; group SOC monitors the legacy tenant sign-ins
treatment_plan: Migrate to SYS-G1 and SYS-G4 by 2027-03-31; Homebuilding supplement and inheritance matrix; network segmentation at sales centers

threat_event: AI used in housing and credit decisions produces unlawful disparities or unreliable valuations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tenant screening never tested for disparities; AVM random sample testing and nondiscrimination review not done; pre-qualification model not monitored by group
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-B4 tenant screening; SYS-M1 pre-qualification model and AVM
regulatory_driver: Reg Z 12 CFR 1026.42(i)(3); Fair Housing Act 42 U.S.C. 3604-3605; ECOA Reg B 12 CFR 1002.9; N53-R02 (45(a))
existing_controls: Group AI Standard (2026); AVM quality control policy (2025)
treatment_plan: Group AI governance program (P10): disparity testing, AVM sample testing, human review, vendor documentation

threat_event: Treasury hub or bank connectivity gateway outage stops disbursements for every division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One bank connectivity vendor connects all 6 banks; only Title has rehearsed the bank-portal fallback
existing_controls: Bank portals with hardware tokens; paper callback log; hub replicated to provider B
treatment_plan: Fallback drills for brokerage escrow and Homebuilding payments; second connectivity path for the two largest trust banks

threat_event: Payee, bank account, and access changes in division applications go undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Audit logs from SYS-B1, SYS-M2, and SYS-H1 do not reach the SIEM; no alerts on payee or bank changes
existing_controls: SIEM covers identity, email, and the portal
treatment_plan: Onboard the three application logs; alert on payee and bank changes; weekly review by division liaisons

threat_event: Breach or prolonged outage at a critical SaaS or hosted vendor affects several divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Transaction platform, loan origination, and title production vendors hold most customer information; the title production vendor RTO exceeds the BIA
existing_controls: Tier 1 vendor SOC 2 reviews; contract security and notice terms
treatment_plan: Contract RTO alignment for title production; vendor access through PAM; annual SOC report reviews for every tier 1 vendor in every division (P09)

threat_event: Home Loans and Title cannot show they oversee the parent as their affiliate service provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The 2021 intercompany services agreement has no security, audit, or incident notice terms; the senior officers overseeing the Qualified Individual have no written procedure
existing_controls: Qualified Individual reports annually to both boards
treatment_plan: Amend the intercompany services agreement; written oversight procedure for the Presidents of Home Loans and Title

threat_event: Over-retained customer information enlarges the scope of any breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No disposal schedule enforced; SYS-B1 keeps files indefinitely; Title scanned files from 2006 to 2015 on a file server
regulatory_driver: N53-R01 (314.4(c)(6)); Fla. Stat. 501.171(8) (worked example); FCRA 16 CFR 682.3
treatment_plan: Group retention schedule; purge records past retention in SYS-B1 and the file server; annual review

threat_event: Smart-home access rights let unauthorized people unlock or control homeowners homes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Builder administrator role kept on about 3,100 closed homes; shared installer passcode on hubs installed in 2023 and 2024
existing_controls: Platform audit log; homeowners can add their own users
treatment_plan: Remove builder roles from all closed homes; rotate installer passcodes remotely; enforce handover checklist before closing

threat_event: An insider colludes to create or change a payee and release funds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dual approval exists, but payee setup and release roles overlap for small teams in some brokerage escrow offices
existing_controls: Dual approval; positive pay; background checks
treatment_plan: Separate payee setup from release in every division; quarterly role review

threat_event: A hurricane disrupts Florida offices, title closing rooms, sales centers, and jobsites
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Most operations and both disbursement centers are in the Southeast; the two centers are about 200 miles apart
existing_controls: Remote work for Title and brokerage staff; cloud-hosted systems
treatment_plan: Accepted with existing remote work and cloud hosting; disbursement center cross-training continues

threat_event: A synthetic voice or video impersonation defeats callback verification
threat_source: Organized fraud groups using generative AI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Callbacks confirm identity by voice only; no shared secret or second channel for high-value changes
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G5 payee verification; Title and treasury staff
existing_controls: Callback to numbers on file only; dual approval
treatment_plan: Add a second factor for payee changes above $100,000 (portal confirmation or in-person); deepfake awareness for Title, escrow, and treasury staff

threat_event: Workforce enters customer information into the enterprise generative AI assistant or public tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot with 3,000 employees; public tools blocked on managed devices only; agents use personal devices
existing_controls: Enterprise tool with no-training terms; POL-05 approved-tools rule
treatment_plan: Data loss prevention rules for the assistant; agent guidance; quarterly prompt sampling

threat_event: The FinCEN residential real estate rule is restored on appeal and Title is not ready to report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rule vacated 2026-03-19 with appeal pending; no reporting procedure kept current
existing_controls: Title compliance officer tracks the appeal
treatment_plan: Keep a ready reporting procedure and data fields in SYS-M2; recheck status each quarter

threat_event: A large funds transfer fraud exceeds the cyber insurance sublimit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: $10 million funds transfer fraud and social engineering sublimit; title disbursements average $208 million a day
treatment_plan: Review sublimit and a crime policy at renewal; recovery procedures with banks
